about: The shared BoxSpec vectors (BC-001), declared by hand: a base fixture, one mutation, and the verdict a reader of box-spec.v1.json and add-ons.v1.json expects. The generator only encodes them (viem) and hashes them; it never runs a validator, so the expected verdicts are an independent oracle for both implementations.

Foundry (test/box/BoxSpecV1Vectors.t.sol) decodes each vector's bytes and runs BoxSpecV1.validate() and specHash(); vitest (packages/box-spec/src/box-spec.test.ts) decodes the same bytes, runs the zod schema, validate() and specHash(), and re-encodes them.
expect: "OK" or [reason, field]; a field is a core field name, "addOns", "addOns.<key>" or "addOns.<key>.<param>".

A string value is a JS string (its UTF-8 bytes go on the wire) or { "rawHex": "0x..." } for bytes no JS string encodes to (invalid UTF-8, a leading BOM); matrix strings "non_ascii_raw" marks the vectors whose bytes an ABI decoder yielding JS strings cannot keep.

Tags: BC-xxx are the conformance cases; "F55 (supersedes BC-066 in part)" marks vectors that follow F55 where BC-066's text (version 2 always refuses placeholders) is not yet amended; F61 L7, F61 O2, F65 and F68 (3) mark the vectors of the fee-model pass (the graduated layout, the creator buy, the royalties add-on and the creator option); F70 and F71 mark the creation-flow pass (the token-only box, the creator kind per fee side and paid in T or Q, the creator-fee cap add-on, the collection page add-on).

Vectors that name the first value past an enum or the catalog (boxType 4, qStream 8, tStream 8, add-on id 7) moved up with F70's new members; three creator-option vectors that F68 (3)'s P rule 'both streams or neither' refused are valid under F70 (per fee side).

F74 marks the vectors of desk round 7: one raise for every box (U5: version 2's context lists 4.206980085 ETH only, so 1, 4.2 and 10 ETH are RAISE_NOT_A_PRESET), the collection cover (U3: field 28, required for a new collection, zero for a token-only box), the creator-fee cap in fixed amounts of native ETH (U2) and, from core v1 (F72 (3)), royalties to CREATOR paid to creatorFeeRecipient (add-on 4 has no recipient). Holder payouts (U1) stay NOT_OFFERED here: the vectors are the factory's check, the strictest network; Demo's wider lists are tested in TypeScript.

core item 9 (SH-core-wave-2 spec change 9, built on sh-f75) marks the vectors of the metadata table's format v1: validate() refuses a table that BoxMetadataTable.validate (the collection's check at initialize) would refuse, with METADATA_TABLE_MALFORMED at metadataTable, after the length check. The 24,575-byte OK vector is now a well-formed table (a 24,571-byte description and no traits); 24,575 bytes of 0xab are malformed.
